event_var.var_meaning: 1 = relapse or death from any cause (RFS event); 0 = censored/alive and relapse-free

notes: The supplementary table explicitly provides 'RFS (months)' and 'RFS Censor'.

The paper defines RFS as time from the date of surgery until disease relapse or death from any cause; patients who remained alive and relapse free were censored at their date of last disease evaluation.

The auxiliary column 'Relapse' has observed values 'Yes' and 'No' and helps confirm recurrence status, but it is not the full RFS event indicator because some rows have 'Relapse' = 'No' with 'Date of Death' present and 'RFS Censor' = 1.
The paper reports post-hoc OS on the same cohort and defines OS as time from the date of surgery until death from any cause; patients who remained alive were censored at their last date known alive.
The supplementary table includes 'Date of Esophageal Surgery' and 'Date of Death' but does not provide an explicit OS duration field or a last-known-alive/censoring field for patients without death.
Therefore OS is described in the paper, but patient-level OS time/event variables cannot be fully extracted from the provided supplementary data.
The paper defines OS after relapse as the time from the date of relapse until death from any cause.

The supplementary table includes 'Date of Relapse or Censoring' and 'Date of Death', but it does not provide an explicit OS-after-relapse duration field or a post-relapse censoring/last-known-alive date for relapsed patients who were still alive.
Therefore OS after relapse cannot be fully extracted as a patient-level time/event variable from the provided supplementary data.
